hero.headline: Serving Christ, Serving Our Neighbors
hero.intro: From caring for our Kendall-Whittier neighbors to supporting missionaries around the world, Grace's ministries put faith into action. Find where you fit in below.

ministries.label: Community Involvement
ministries.summary: Grace supports Kendall-Whittier Elementary families, operates an emergency clothes closet, and partners with Meals on Wheels, alongside our ongoing ecumenical and campus ministry work.

ministries.label: Serving at Grace
ministries.summary: From worship servers and readers to Grace Night cooks and helpers, there's a place for you to put your gifts to use in the life of our congregation.

ministries.label: Missions
ministries.summary: Grace supports missionaries around the world, from church planting in Uruguay to Bible translation in Southern Africa, alongside the ongoing work of Lutheran Women in Mission.

ministries.label: Music
ministries.summary: Our Adult Chancel Choir, Handbell Choir, Cantate Children's Choir, and instrumentalists lead worship each week and carry on Tulsa's century-old Handel's Messiah tradition.

ministries.label: The St. Andrew Society
ministries.summary: Established in 2019, the St. Andrew Society trains committed lay members to serve as crucifers, torch bearers, gospel bearers, and communion assistants in the Divine Service.

ministries.label: Youth Life
ministries.summary: From Sunday School and Grace Night to Higher Things and Vacation Bible School, our youth grow in faith and fellowship together.
